stones.inscription: Here the lineage kept fire on loan from lightning. Balance never returned.
The grass was bent into a crop; the crop bent the lineage back. Rent is still accruing.
Value went abstract and reality complied. Mind the debasement clause.
The roads remain; the password is lost. Copy everything; filing is survival.
Information's price collapsed. The invoice arrived as reformation, plague, and science.
The horizon became a shipping lane. Silver one way, consequences the other.
Rights arrived as pamphlets; pamphlets became armies. Every clause costs somebody.
Coal is Carboniferous sunlight with the receipt attached. The smoke keeps score.
Power went liquid and the century arranged itself around the pump. Ambition: quarterly.
Efficiency reported here wearing a uniform. Entropy checked no passports.
The atom split and issued a clock. Midnight stays close enough to hear.
The era accelerated to catch a beeping sound. The scoreboard stands yet.
Compute doubled on schedule and the schedule became the economy. Interest compounds.
The coal era's invoice was totaled and seated at the table. It speaks sometimes.
Attention was extracted twenty-four hours daily. The feed feeds back.
Between stars, a whispered word costs a year. Nothing happened, diligently.
Copying completed; litigation began. The heirs are you, personally, immediately.
